column1: What did Grendel carry to hold his victims?
column2: Grendel carried a pouch made of dragon skins.
Hygelac is killed on a raid into Friesland.

column1: Who guides Beowulf to the dragon's barrow?
column2: The thief who stole the cup guides them against his will.

column1: Where does Beowulf ask to be buried?
column2: Beowulf asks for a barrow on the headland at Hronesness.

column1: Who says "A warrior will sooner die than live a life of shame"?
column2: Wiglaf says it while condemning the warriors who deserted Beowulf.
